name: toolbox-marketplace
description: Small, independent utilities for Claude Code, each packaged as its own plugin. Install only the ones you need.

plugins.name: aesthetic-code
plugins.description: Makes Claude write readable, visually pleasant code: well spaced, with good names and best practices.

plugins.name: copy-style
plugins.description: Makes Claude write consistent copy: sentence case, one term per concept and the same tone everywhere.
